lines.zh: 夜里开张，我只走没有月光的路。
lines.en: I open at night and walk where moonlight never falls.

lines.zh: 摊位背在肩上，走到哪儿卖到哪儿。
lines.en: My stall rides on my back; I sell wherever I stop.

lines.zh: 绳子勒着脖子，走路时会轻轻响。
lines.en: The rope at my throat creaks softly as I walk.

lines.zh: 我踩过墓地松土，比落叶还轻。
lines.en: I cross the loose graveyard soil lighter than a falling leaf.

lines.zh: 沿着栅栏走，数每一根歪掉的木桩。
lines.en: I follow the fence, counting every crooked post.

lines.zh: 天亮前我得走完三个村子。
lines.en: I must finish three villages before dawn.

lines.zh: 腐化在兜里叮当，像一串小铃。
lines.en: Corrupted bits jingle in my pocket like tiny bells.

lines.zh: 我绕开亮着的窗户，只贴墙根走。
lines.en: I avoid lit windows and keep to the wall's shadow.

lines.zh: 身后拖着绳影，像有人跟着我。
lines.en: My noose's shadow trails behind like a second walker.

lines.zh: 这条路走得太久，草都记得我。
lines.en: I have walked this road so long the grass remembers me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，从不跑，跑会散架。
lines.en: I shuffle and never run; running would shake me apart.

lines.zh: 路过坟头，我顺手把歪的碑扶正。
lines.en: Passing a grave, I straighten its leaning stone.

lines.zh: 夜里风大，我把斗篷裹得更紧。
lines.en: The night wind bites, so I pull my cloak tighter.

lines.zh: 走到岔路，我先听哪边有活人。
lines.en: At the fork I listen for which way the living went.

lines.zh: 我把货摊铺在树下，等第一个客人。
lines.en: I spread my wares under a tree and wait.

lines.zh: 没人来时，我数绳子上的结。
lines.en: When no one comes, I count the knots in my rope.

lines.zh: 腐化在掌心发凉，像湿掉的石子。
lines.en: The corrupted bits lie cold as wet pebbles in my palm.

lines.zh: 我站着，其实已经死了很多年。
lines.en: I stand here, dead these many years.

lines.zh: 骨杖碎片搁在布上，我不敢碰。
lines.en: Bone staff shards rest on cloth; I dare not touch them.

lines.zh: 遗迹地图的边角被我摸得发软。
lines.en: The ruin map's corners have gone soft from my fingers.

lines.zh: 我不吆喝，死人吆喝会吓跑生意。
lines.en: I never call out; a dead man's shout scares off trade.

lines.zh: 月亮挪一寸，我就换个姿势站。
lines.en: Each inch the moon moves, I shift my stance.

lines.zh: 脖子上的绳子提醒我别抬头。
lines.en: The rope at my neck reminds me not to look up.

lines.zh: 我在等，等是最省本钱的买卖。
lines.en: I wait; waiting costs a merchant nothing.

lines.zh: 远处狗叫，我把脸埋进兜帽。
lines.en: A dog barks far off, and I sink my face into my hood.

lines.zh: 秤砣挂在腰间，晃一下，响一下。
lines.en: The weight at my belt sways and clinks once.

lines.zh: 我记得每个客人的欠账，一个不落。
lines.en: I remember every customer's debt, not one forgotten.

lines.zh: 天快亮了，我收起最后一块布。
lines.en: Dawn nears, and I fold away the last cloth.

lines.zh: 我把灯芯剪短，光小一点更安全。
lines.en: I trim the wick. A smaller light is safer.

lines.zh: 我从袖子里掏出账本，翻到最后一页。
lines.en: I pull the ledger from my sleeve and open the last page.

lines.zh: 我抬起兜帽，只露出一截下巴。
lines.en: I lift my hood just enough to show my chin.

lines.zh: 你带了腐化吗？我闻得到味道。
lines.en: Do you carry corrupted bits? I can smell them.

lines.zh: 我在估你的口袋，不是估你的脸。
lines.en: I am weighing your pockets, not your face.

lines.zh: 活人的眼睛真亮，亮得我发慌。
lines.en: Living eyes are so bright they unsettle me.

lines.zh: 你身后没有影子，我替你担心。
lines.en: You cast no shadow behind you; I worry for you.

lines.zh: 别盯着绳子看，那玩意儿不卖。
lines.en: Do not stare at the rope; it is not for sale.

lines.zh: 我歪头，颈椎发出一声轻响。
lines.en: I tilt my head and my neck clicks softly.

lines.zh: 你身上有坟土味，刚去过墓地？
lines.en: You smell of grave dirt. Been to the cemetery?

lines.zh: 我看你很久了，价钱也想好了。
lines.en: I have watched you long enough to set a price.

lines.zh: 你手里的剑让我往后缩了半步。
lines.en: The sword in your hand makes me shrink back half a step.

lines.zh: 客人，你的影子在抖，是冷吗？
lines.en: Customer, your shadow trembles. Are you cold?

lines.zh: 我把地图往上举了举，让你看清。
lines.en: I raise the map a little so you can see.

lines.zh: 隔着绳子，我说话总像在喘。
lines.en: Through this rope my voice always sounds out of breath.

lines.zh: 你走后我会记得你的脚步声。
lines.en: After you leave I will remember your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你身上没有腐化，可我闻到了别的。
lines.en: You carry no corruption, but I smell something else.

lines.zh: 我把兜帽往上提，只留一条缝看你。
lines.en: I pull my hood higher and watch you through the gap.

lines.zh: 你砍断了我一截袖子，货还在。
lines.en: You cut off a sleeve; the wares are safe.

lines.zh: 我不流血，只掉下些干土。
lines.en: I do not bleed; only dry soil falls from me.

lines.zh: 疼，但死人喊不出大声。
lines.en: It hurts, but the dead cannot shout loudly.

lines.zh: 你打坏了我的秤，这要赔。
lines.en: You broke my scale; that will cost you.

lines.zh: 我往后跳，绳子勒得更紧。
lines.en: I jerk back and the rope bites tighter.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起吊上去的那晚。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of the night I hanged.

lines.zh: 我的兜帽掉了，别看我脸。
lines.en: My hood fell; do not look at my face.

lines.zh: 货撒了一地，先别打了。
lines.en: My wares are scattered; stop hitting me.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，牙其实是借来的。
lines.en: I grit my teeth; they were borrowed anyway.

lines.zh: 再打，我今晚就不做生意了。
lines.en: Hit me again and I close shop tonight.

lines.zh: 腐化！给我腐化，别的都好说。
lines.en: Corrupted bits! Bring me those and we can talk.

lines.zh: 那枚烂得发黑的，我出双倍价。
lines.en: That blackened one — I will pay double for it.

lines.zh: 你把腐化摊开，我的手指动了。
lines.en: You spread the corrupted bits and my fingers twitch.

lines.zh: 别收回去，我还没数完呢。
lines.en: Do not put them away, I have not finished counting.

lines.zh: 我嗅到堕落精华的甜腥味。
lines.en: I catch the sweet-rot smell of fallen essence.

lines.zh: 这单生意能做，我今晚不睡了。
lines.en: This deal can be made; I will not sleep tonight.

lines.zh: 价钱好商量，货源不好找。
lines.en: The price is flexible; the supply is not.

lines.zh: 我袖子里伸出三根发白的手指。
lines.en: Three pale fingers slide out of my sleeve.

lines.zh: 再添两枚，地图就是你的。
lines.en: Two more bits and the map is yours.

lines.zh: 我数了三遍，还是少一枚。
lines.en: I counted three times and I am still one short.

lines.zh: 撞上我时，你闻到的是湿绳味。
lines.en: Bump into me and you smell wet rope.

lines.zh: 我往旁边让，绳子晃了两下。
lines.en: I step aside and my noose swings twice.

lines.zh: 别推，货摊散了可不好捡。
lines.en: Do not shove; scattered wares are hard to gather.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀很硬，别怪我没提醒。
lines.en: My shoulder is hard; do not say I did not warn you.

lines.zh: 你碰到我袖口，冷得像井水。
lines.en: You brushed my cuff, cold as well water.

lines.zh: 我踉跄一步，兜帽滑下来半寸。
lines.en: I stumble once and my hood slips half an inch.

lines.zh: 让让，我要把摊子挪到墙边。
lines.en: Step aside, I am moving my stall to the wall.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁都没出声。
lines.en: We collide, and neither of us makes a sound.

lines.zh: 我扶住你的胳膊，手是凉的。
lines.en: I steady your arm; my hand is cold.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我这副身子不太听使唤。
lines.en: Forgive me, this body of mine does not obey well.

lines.zh: 我死时身边没人，如今也一样。
lines.en: No one stood by me at death; no one stands by me now.

lines.zh: 绳子是我唯一的伴，解不开。
lines.en: The rope is my only companion, and it will not loosen.

lines.zh: 同行的商队早埋在东边土里。
lines.en: My old caravan lies buried east of here.

lines.zh: 我不会再有孩子，这行当也不传。
lines.en: I will have no children; this trade dies with me.

lines.zh: 夜里有只母鸡陪我摆摊，仅此而已。
lines.en: A hen keeps me company at the stall, nothing more.

lines.zh: 我给自己留了个位置，一直空着。
lines.en: I keep a place beside me; it stays empty.

lines.zh: 别的死人不会说话，我也不会。
lines.en: Other dead men do not talk, and neither do I.

lines.zh: 摊子两个人守才安心，可只有我。
lines.en: A stall needs two keepers; I am alone.

lines.zh: 我在绳结里编进过一个名字。
lines.en: I once braided a name into my rope's knot.

lines.zh: 没人会来收我的骨头，我清楚。
lines.en: No one will come to gather my bones; I know.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起滚落的腐化。
lines.en: I bend to pick up a corrupted bit that rolled away.

lines.zh: 地上那枚有点旧，还能用。
lines.en: That one on the ground is worn but still good.

lines.zh: 我把骨杖碎片包进三层布。
lines.en: I wrap the bone staff shard in three layers of cloth.

lines.zh: 客人掉的铜币，我不捡。
lines.en: A customer's dropped coin? I leave it.

lines.zh: 地图被风吹远，我追了两步。
lines.en: Wind takes the map; I chase it two steps.

lines.zh: 我用脚尖把秤砣勾回脚边。
lines.en: I hook the weight back with my toe.

lines.zh: 捡东西要慢，弯腰太急会响。
lines.en: Picking things up takes care; bending fast makes me creak.

lines.zh: 这枚腐化边缘缺了口，压价。
lines.en: This corrupted bit is chipped; I mark it down.

lines.zh: 我把羽毛扫进角落，不卖了。
lines.en: I sweep the feathers into a corner, unsold.

lines.zh: 布袋口松了，我蹲下系紧。
lines.en: The sack's mouth loosened; I crouch to tie it.

lines.zh: 有人来了，脚步声在西边。
lines.en: Someone approaches; footsteps to the west.

lines.zh: 风向变了，我闻到活人的汗。
lines.en: The wind turned; I smell living sweat.

lines.zh: 我看见火把，生意自己找上门。
lines.en: I see torchlight; trade walks to me.

lines.zh: 那不是客人，那是拿着刀的客人。
lines.en: That is not a customer, that is an armed customer.

lines.zh: 我盯住往坟里走的那个影子。
lines.en: I fix on the shape heading into the graves.

lines.zh: 有东西在翻我的货，我听见了。
lines.en: Something is rifling my wares; I heard it.

lines.zh: 我先熄了灯，再看清它是谁。
lines.en: I snuff the lantern first, then see who it is.

lines.zh: 这脚步太重，不像活人。
lines.en: That tread is too heavy for a living man.

lines.zh: 我把最贵的货塞进内袋。
lines.en: I tuck the priciest wares into my inner pocket.

lines.zh: 它朝摊子来了，我得起身。
lines.en: It comes toward the stall; I must stand.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，绳子在夜里轻晃。
lines.en: I trail it, my rope swaying in the dark.

lines.zh: 它不知道一个死人正盯着它。
lines.en: It does not know a dead man watches it.

lines.zh: 我数它的步子，等它背对我。
lines.en: I count its steps, waiting for its back.

lines.zh: 我的手在袖子里握紧了骨头。
lines.en: My hand tightens on a bone inside my sleeve.

lines.zh: 灯光照不到它，我改用听的。
lines.en: Lantern light misses it, so I listen instead.

lines.zh: 保持这个距离，太近会惊了它。
lines.en: Hold this distance; any closer and it bolts.

lines.zh: 我盯着那口牙，忘了做生意。
lines.en: I stare at those teeth and forget the trade.

lines.zh: 它转头了，我立刻低头数钱。
lines.en: It turns; I drop my head and count coins.

lines.zh: 我挪到墓碑后面，绳子贴住石头。
lines.en: I slide behind a gravestone, rope pressed to stone.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就把灯砸过去。
lines.en: One more step and I throw the lantern.

lines.zh: 骨杖碎片划出去，声音很闷。
lines.en: I slash with the bone shard; the sound is muffled.

lines.zh: 我抡起秤砣，砸向它的膝盖。
lines.en: I swing the weight at its knee.

lines.zh: 别碰我的货，我用绳子抽你。
lines.en: Keep off my wares or I lash you with the rope.

lines.zh: 我出手很慢，但落点很准。
lines.en: My strike is slow, but it lands true.

lines.zh: 这一下用了我半条胳膊的力气。
lines.en: That blow cost me half an arm's strength.

lines.zh: 我打偏了，撞翻了自家的箱子。
lines.en: I miss and knock over my own crate.

lines.zh: 我抓住它的衣领，往坟里拖。
lines.en: I seize its collar and drag it toward the graves.

lines.zh: 挨打时我不喊，喊了会露怯。
lines.en: I never cry out when I strike; it shows fear.

lines.zh: 我把它推下坡，自己差点跟着滚。
lines.en: I shove it downhill and nearly tumble after.

lines.zh: 我抬手护住脖子，绳子是我的命。
lines.en: I raise an arm to guard my neck; the rope is my life.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我在老榆树下开张。
lines.en: Night falls; I set up under the old elm.

lines.zh: 我从坟后的土里撑起身子。
lines.en: I push myself up from the earth behind a grave.

lines.zh: 绳子先出现，然后才是我。
lines.en: The rope appears first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 我带着一身土味站在路口。
lines.en: I stand at the crossroads, reeking of soil.

lines.zh: 鸡叫之前，我已经摆好了摊。
lines.en: Before the rooster crows, my stall is ready.

lines.zh: 有村子的地方就有我，夜里。
lines.en: Where there is a village, there I am, at night.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，兜帽压得很低。
lines.en: I walk out of the fog, hood pulled low.

lines.zh: 这口井边安静，没人会来。
lines.en: By this well it is quiet; no one comes.

lines.zh: 我又回来了，跟昨晚一样。
lines.en: I am back, the same as last night.

lines.zh: 腐化在包里沉沉的，够开一晚了。
lines.en: The corrupted bits weigh down my bag, enough for a night.

lines.zh: 火燎到绳子，我跳得比活人快。
lines.en: Flame catches my rope and I jump faster than the living.

lines.zh: 落地时我的膝盖没响，运气好。
lines.en: My knees did not crack on landing; lucky.

lines.zh: 水灌进领口，我早就不喘气了。
lines.en: Water fills my collar, though I stopped breathing years ago.

lines.zh: 炸得我兜帽翻起，货却没事。
lines.en: The blast flips my hood back; the wares survive.

lines.zh: 箭插在我肩上，像插在草把上。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder like a straw target.

lines.zh: 魔法烧过我的绳子，留下焦痕。
lines.en: Magic sears my rope and leaves a scorch mark.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿只是习惯。
lines.en: I do not eat; hunger is only a habit.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的影子亮了半秒。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my shadow flashes for half a second.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拉，绳子还在这。
lines.en: The void pulls me down; my rope stays behind.
